messages:
maya: Morning async — quick desk check before the 09:15 handoff.
maya: Current queue: 48 open, 3 high-priority, 7 awaiting engineering. Volume down ~8% vs last shift.
maya: Known issue: webhook delivery latencies spiked around 03:45 UTC (5 customers reported delays). Logged on our incident tracker.
ben: Oncall here — I rolled back the consumer rate-limit change at 04:00 which reduced immediate errors, but some delayed deliveries still trickling through.
liz: Seeing a few customers asking for an ETA. Drafting a short macro to use in ticket replies. Suggesting text below.
liz: ```
Hi — thanks for the report. We’re currently investigating an issue causing webhook delivery delays. We’ve identified a partial service degradation and are working on a fix; expected recovery within 1–2 hours. We’ll update this ticket as soon as we have more details. Apologies for the disruption.
— Redwood Support
```
sanjay: Engineering note: root cause looks like a consumer-group backlog on the ingest pipeline (consumer falling behind under burst). Reproducer in staging; prepping a backpressure/commit-fix PR. Will post link shortly.
maya: I moved tickets 3245, 3250, 3253 to awaiting-engineering and flagged as needs-escalation if customer SLA is hit.
ben: Can we add a short public macro for the status page + ETA? Also PR #1423 is awaiting review from eng — @sanjay can you take a look?
sanjay: Will review PR #1423 before EOD and prioritize the consumer fix for a canary deploy.
infra-bot: Deploy pipeline: consumer-patch build passed, staging tests green. Canary planned at 60% traffic.
maya: Action items: ben — keep an eye on queue and escalate if >10 customers affected; liz — publish and apply the webhook-delay macro to affected tickets; sanjay — review and merge the consumer fix; I'll run the morning handoff doc update at 09:15 PT.
liz: Publishing macro now as macro_webhook_delay_v2 — added ETA language and troubleshooting steps (resend webhook, check retry settings).
maya: Please add a one-line note to the handoff doc: /docs/support/hand-offs (link) about the webhook latency and macro id.
deploy-bot: Canary finished: no error spikes at 60% — rolling to prod in 5m.
ben: Copy that. I'll watch for any regression post-rollout and will escalate to P1 if errors spike. Pager is active.
maya: Thanks everyone. If you see new customer hits, reply in this thread and tag me. :coffee:
